row.title: A second route written in one entry point is dead if the loop calls another
row.body: MODELS-ORG-1 added the GitHub Models org-endpoint fallback in agents.invoke, but the executor calls agent_ladder.transport, which built and sent the request itself, so the fallback never ran and every executor run failed on 200 text/plain OK. Both now go through agents.request.

title: A second route written in one entry point is dead if the loop calls another
